description: Registry of LLM agent skills shipped under src/resources/skills. Each entry points to exactly one <skill-id>/SKILL.md. Adding a skill requires only a new skill directory plus one entry here; no source-code change is needed.

skills.name: eatspot-discovery
skills.description: Discover and validate bars, pastry shops, restaurants, cafes, and bakeries for breakfast, lunch, or dinner using the 18 mcp-google-map MCP tools exclusively, enforcing budget, quality-grade, category, opening-hours, and distance constraints on verifiable Google Places API (New) data.
